_note: The mentor beat: someone teaches or equips the protagonist, or says what the protagonist cannot yet hear. (Save the Cat's B story; the Hero's Journey's Meeting the Mentor.) Frames, as everywhere: see act_turn's note.
entries: {SOMEONE:!threatening} took {first} aside at {landmark} and taught {first} to {DO_THING} {THING}.
At {landmark}, {SOMEONE:human,!threatening} gave {first} {THING:portable} and one piece of advice about {TOPIC}.
{CLOSE:human} introduced {first} to {SOMEONE:!threatening}, who knew all about {TOPIC}.
{SOMEONE:!threatening} saw what {first} could do and told {CLOSE:human}.
{first} found {SOMEONE:!threatening} at {landmark}, who asked nothing and spoke of {TOPIC}.
{SOMEONE:!threatening} listened to {first} talk about {TOPIC}, and said little.
